title: Longitudinal and personalized networks of eating disorder cognitions and behaviors: Targets for precision intervention a proof of concept study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network, intraindividual network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited number of assessment points (28); - No formal recommendations for network analysis in EMA; - No specific measures designed for EMA network analysis; - No established replicability of within-person networks; - Potential instability in network structures.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code is declared available but data availability is not explicitly stated. The study is a proof-of-concept with limited generalizability.
